name: seasons-end-destroy-withered-only
notes: The starting champion (Spirit of Water) is CardID-patched directly to Diao Chan, Idyll Corsage (d7l6i5thdy, the deck's own level-3 champion) for IsDiaoChanBonus and TERA unlock, same technique as ripples-of-atrophy-two-wither-counters. Two objects are pre-seeded with wither counters directly via setProperties (Counters: {wither:N}) on both sides of the field (an opponent Dungeon Guide with wither:3, and the caster's OWN Fluffy Shopkeep with wither:1), plus a third, clean Dungeon Guide with no wither counters on the caster's own field as the negative-path control. activationCostModifierAbilities["ddggqvxw8f:0"] (GeneratedMacroCode.php ~8429) reduces the printed 10-reserve cost by 1 per withered object found via array_merge(GetField(1), GetField(2)) -- with 2 withered objects seeded, net cost is 10-2=8. Four extra filler cards are seeded into hand on top of the natural starting hand so the 8-reserve cost can actually be paid in full. cardActivatedAbilities["ddggqvxw8f:0"] (~17528, comment "Wither Purge") iterates both fields and calls DoSacrificeFighter on every non-champion object with a wither counter greater than 0 -- there is no player-chosen targeting for this card, so the "only withered objects die" outcome IS the semantic proof, per the guide's negative-path guidance for implicit-targeting effects. Both withered objects move to their owners' graveyards (a real destroy, not a silent counter/removal), while the clean Dungeon Guide remains alive and untouched on the caster's field. Destroying the opponent's non-token object also triggered Diao Chan, Idyll Corsage's own passive ("Whenever a non-token object an opponent controls is destroyed, you may banish it...", the DiaoChanIdyllBanish decision) as a side effect confirming a real destroy event fired; that optional banish offer is declined (NO) to keep this fixture scoped to Season's End itself.

rulesClauses: Destroy each object with a wither counter on it.
[Diao Chan Bonus] This card costs 1 less for each wither counter on objects on the field.
